# Parameter formats

command reference

## 1) Positional parameter

Specify the parameters in order.
Parameters not explicitly listed as "Keyword parameter" in the [command reference](../command/README.md) are "Positional parameter".

```text
Example:
  ttlcommand 10 20
  1st : width
  2nd : height
```

## 2) Keyword parameter

Passing keyword/value pairs as parameter.
Parameter can be passed in any order.

```text
Example:
  ttlcommand 'width=10' 'height=20'
  width keyword  : width
  height keyword : height
```

## 3) Positional parameter + Keyword parameter

The first few are "Positional parameter", the rest are "Keyword parameter".
"Positional parameter" order is fixed, "Keyword parameter" is in no particular order.

```text
Example:
  ttlcommand 'Terminal' 'green' 'width=10' 'height=20'
  1st            : font
  2nd            : color
  width keyword  : width
  height keyword : height
```

## Background

"Keyword parameters" was introduced in Tera Term version 5.3 when the [listbox](../command/listbox.md) command enhance to pass many parameters, and besides, to minimize the number of parameters to be specified.
